rationale: Two columns: large rounded image left, editorial text (tag, H2, paragraph, button) right, vertically centered.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: two-column featured article: image on one side, editorial text on the other

contentPattern.description: Fixed two-part side-by-side layout (image | text) that never wraps into a list: Columns.
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 image; cell 2 tag paragraph, H2 heading, paragraph, CTA link. Additional rows stack as further feature rows

usage: Use to feature a single article or story with a large image next to its summary.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any fixed image | text split. Swap cell order to put the image on the right. For a repeating list of items use a cards block.
